title: Need to run the air condition below 60 degrees to get serious cool.
text:
Need to run the air condition below 60 degrees to get serious cool.. Well my confusion is in the "draining" of the thing. I never figured out how it drained, or if it needed to be drained. But, I put this in the larger living room, and it seemed to be cooling, but you need to have it at 60 degrees. Sixty degrees is cold in air condition talk, but for a room, it is not cooling.

I used it in the small bedroom also. And, I think that you have to run the air condition at 60 or lower to get it to remain cool. The hose is stiff and I placed it out the window. I will used it more next summer and see about the drain thing. I couldn't figure it out.
